PointerOwnershipTests.test_primary_canno.note: PostgreSQL creates the Work and its primary Manifestation in one transaction with a deferred key, so a pointer need not start NULL.

PointerOwnershipTests.test_origin_mappin.obsolete: origin_work_id was the SQLite backfill's mapping from a legacy Work to its rows; PostgreSQL has no origin column.

PointerOwnershipTests.test_mirrored_colu.obsolete: The SQLite compatibility mirror (triggers that copy legacy works columns into Manifestation and Asset rows) has no PostgreSQL counterpart: PostgreSQL has no legacy source columns, and a Work's Asset is written by its create or source command.

TransitionTests.test_abandoned_retiremen.note: SQLite needed a work_retirement marker table to allow a primary-less Work inside a transaction; PostgreSQL's deferred NOT NULL pointer key does the same job, so there is no marker to abandon.

TransitionTests.test_direct_bypasses_are.obsolete: Guards of SQLite's work_retirement and work_retirement_guard tables, which exist only to emulate deferred keys; PostgreSQL uses deferred constraints (tests/pg/test_works_schema.py::WorkPointerTests).

UpgradedIntegrityTests.test_whole_work_d.note: SQLite schema v16 to v17 upgrade (backfill of the Work identity rows). PostgreSQL starts from its own baseline schema and there is no SQLite to PostgreSQL migration before 1.0 (#613, R20); its migration runner is covered by tests/pg/test_migrate.py.

MirrorTests.test_metadata_only_work_gets.note: The SQLite compatibility mirror (triggers that copy legacy works columns into Manifestation and Asset rows) has no PostgreSQL counterpart: PostgreSQL has no legacy source columns, and a Work's Asset is written by its create or source command. A Work without a file gains no Asset from thumb_page: the field is refused (WRONG_OPERATION_FOR_SOURCE), and Manifestation fields such as doi land on the Manifestation.

MirrorTests.test_annotation_on_a_file_le.note: On PostgreSQL annotations belong to a managed PDF Asset; a Work without one refuses them instead of creating an Asset.

MirrorTests.test_asset_bound_revision_al.obsolete: The SQLite compatibility mirror (triggers that copy legacy works columns into Manifestation and Asset rows) has no PostgreSQL counterpart: PostgreSQL has no legacy source columns, and a Work's Asset is written by its create or source command. A revision row never creates an Asset on PostgreSQL.

MirrorTests.test_deleting_a_verified_inf.note: SQLite Works could lose their stored kind and be inferred as videos from a URL; on PostgreSQL the source is decided once at create and a URL patch never changes it, so a plain Work's URL is always its Manifestation's citation URL. The legacy_inferred_video_urls verdict table has no counterpart.

MirrorTests.test_ensure_origin_asset_is_.note: The SQLite compatibility mirror (triggers that copy legacy works columns into Manifestation and Asset rows) has no PostgreSQL counterpart: PostgreSQL has no legacy source columns, and a Work's Asset is written by its create or source command. PostgreSQL writes the Asset with the Work instead of creating it lazily.
